WITH sex_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    p.SEX,
    COUNT(*) as test_records
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.SEX
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(test_records) as total_records,
    AVG(test_records) as avg_per_sex
  FROM sex_counts
)
SELECT 
  sc.SEX,
  sc.test_records,
  sc.test_records / s.total_records as share,
  sc.test_records - s.avg_per_sex as above_average
FROM sex_counts sc
CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE sc.test_records > s.avg_per_sex
ORDER BY sc.test_records DESC
